query:
Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
name: CI
on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
      - '**' # matches every branch
  push:
    branches:
      - main
    tags: '*'
jobs:
  test:
    name: Tests, Julia ${{ matrix.version }} - ${{ matrix.os }} - ${{ matrix.arch }} - ${{ github.event_name }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        version:
          - '1'
        os:  [ubuntu-latest] # adjust according to need, e.g. os: [ubuntu-latest] if testing only on linux
        arch:
          - x64
    steps:
      # Cancel ongoing CI test runs if pushing to branch again before the previous tests
      # have finished
      - name: Cancel ongoing test runs for previous commits
        uses: styfle/cancel-workflow-action@0.6.0
        with:
          access_token: ${{ github.token }}

      # Do tests
      - uses: actions/checkout@v2
      - uses: julia-actions/setup-julia@v1
        with:
          version: ${{ matrix.version }}
          arch: ${{ matrix.arch }}
      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        env:
          cache-name: cache-artifacts
        with:
          path: ~/.julia/artifacts
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-test-${{ env.cache-name }}-${{ hashFiles('**/Project.toml') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-test-${{ env.cache-name }}-
            ${{ runner.os }}-test-
            ${{ runner.os }}-
      - uses: julia-actions/julia-buildpkg@v1

      - uses: julia-actions/julia-runtest@v1
      - uses: julia-actions/julia-processcoverage@v1
      - uses: codecov/codecov-action@v1
        with:
          file: lcov.info

results.content:
Cancel superseded runs

Pattern: P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE (stale_run_cancellation)

When is cancel superseded runs applicable?

Assess cancel superseded runs for this repository, preserve its required checks, and propose a minimal change or NO_CHANGE.

Preconditions: Runs represent the same workflow and branch or PR; A newer revision supersedes older checks

Contraindications: Release or deployment work; Distinct branches share a cancellation group

Method: Partition cancellation by workflow and branch/PR; Preserve run identity and audit records

Reported finding: Superseding runs can reduce duplicate work.

Reported metrics: {"vm_time_reduction_percent": {"free": 1.9, "paid": 4.1}}

Source: Resource Usage and Optimization Opportunities in Workflows of GitHub Actions (2024), 4.2.3; Table 4; PDF pp. 7: https://software-lab.org/publications/icse2024_workflows.pdf

Literature example before:

# ANALYST ILLUSTRATION; NOT PAPER CODE; NOT EXECUTED
finish every revision's CI run


Literature example after:

# ANALYST ILLUSTRATION; NOT PAPER CODE; NOT EXECUTED
cancel an older run only when a newer run supersedes it

name: CI
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    env:
      MIX_ENV: test
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          # 1.16 is the floor mix.lock permits: multipart requires ~> 1.16.
          # The library itself still supports older, but is not tested there.
          - pair:
              elixir: "1.16"
              otp: "26.2"
          - pair:
              elixir: "1.19"
              otp: "28.1"
            lint: lint
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - uses: erlef/setup-beam@main
        with:
          otp-version: ${{matrix.pair.otp}}
          elixir-version: ${{matrix.pair.elixir}}

      - uses: actions/cache@v3
        with:
          path: deps
          key: mix-deps-${{ hashFiles('**/mix.lock') }}

      - run: mix deps.get

      - run: mix format --check-formatted
        if: ${{ matrix.lint }}

      - run: mix deps.unlock --check-unused
        if: ${{ matrix.lint }}

      - run: mix deps.compile

      - run: mix compile --warnings-as-errors
        if: ${{ matrix.lint }}

      - run: mix test
        if: ${{ ! matrix.lint }}

      - run: mix test --warnings-as-errors
        if: ${{ matrix.lint }}
